Earlier that year, Russia illegally annexed Crimea, and our co-founder Galina Timchenko was fired as editor-in-chief of the popular news portal Lenta.ru, prompting mass resignations in the newsroom. Starting a news organization abroad may have seemed like a drastic way to keep reporting independently on Russia, but Meduza was never timid. Also, in retrospect, it was a prescient move.
